text:
maria: Quick: we need a compact benchmark narrative for next Thurs launch. Outcome = 1 short launch post, a 3-chart "mini-deck", and a 20-min webinar that drives demo signups. Primary theme = latency vs token cost, with clear inbound routing.
emily: audience? we can target platform engs first, then a lighter SMB variant.
raj: agree platform engs first. they will care about p95/p99 + how batching/quantization shifts cost.
josh: current rough numbers to validate: median gen ~ 90ms, p95 ~ 240ms, p99 ~ 490ms on hosted standard. baseline cost ~ $0.24 / 1k tokens. i'll run a fresh job tonight to lock numbers.
olga: I'll pull customer-slice data for hosted vs dedicated. small ask: do we show $/1k tokens or $/1k requests for concrete demo flows?
maria: put $/1k tokens in headline, and include a worked example showing $ per 500-token response and $ per 1000-request run in appendix.
emily: chart set proposal (3 charts):
  1) econ scatter: latency (x) vs $/1k tokens (y) by model+quant variant, annotate tradeoffs
  2) waterfall: unit cost breakdown (compute, memory, orchestration) for Hosted vs Dedicated
  3) tail map: heatmap of p99 latency by sequence length bucket
Keep visuals simple and annotation-driven.
raj: messaging skeleton: two short variants to test on landing/webinar reg: 
  A) "Predictable latency, transparent unit economics."
  B) "Keep interactions snappy without burning budget on idle GPUs."
emily: A is platform tone; B is more product/SaaS. we'll A/B test in social and reg copy.
josh: technical footnotes: include test config (model, region, batch policy, token length distribution) and a small note on quantized quality: "measured embedding cosine delta <0.002 on our eval set". don't bury it, but don't oversell.
benchbot: figma draft: https://figma.com/file/redwood/launch-sparkmap (page: "spark-map-v1"). comments enabled.
maria: ownership (48h ETA):
  - emily: post + webinar script + social blurbs
  - raj: build Figma charts and copy annotations
  - josh: run validation jobs & draft appendix test matrix
  - olga: analytics slices + reg form routing rules
ollga: noted. setting up GA events + Segment mapping. will add hidden reg fields: `priority_latency` and `priority_cost`.
maria: routing rules for SDRs:
  - if "priority_latency" AND p99 requirement > 300ms -> tag "dedicated-sales"
  - if high spend (top decile $/month) -> tag "cost-review"
  - else -> standard nurture flow
emily: webinar format: 20-min talk, 10-min live Q, 1 live demo (two quick use cases). CTA = book dedicated demo or claim hosted credits.
raj: add a customer vignette (anonymized) slide comparing before/after latency & cost impact. keeps it concrete.
josh: example calc for the post: 500-token response at $0.24/1k => $0.12 per response. i'll produce the exact arithmetic in the appendix.
maria: copy length targets: post 300-450 words, deck <= 5 slides, social snippets 1-2 lines.
benchbot: Reminder: ping #eng-runtime before publish to capture infra snapshot.
emily: I'll draft copy & slide text in 36h.
raj: I'll upload chart PNGs + figma annotations in 36h.
josh: fresh numbers posted by tomorrow morning.
olga: funnel tracking doc link when done.
maria: final: keep claims tight, show configuration details, include a worked example, and add clear routing tags on the reg form. thanks team :rocket: 
emily: :thumbsup:
benchbot: :bell: calendar dry-run scheduled 48h from now.
